ETH.note: The article states nothing on AI rules or an authority.
The assistant is an education sector tool, not general administration.

facts.fact: Birr Metrics reports the Ministry of Education has completed testing in selected schools of an AI-powered teacher assistant for grades 9-12 and will begin national deployment.

systems.platform: offline application with grade 9-12 textbook content

ETH.note: The article says the tool was developed in partnership with Huawei but does not say what was built in the country.
The article gives no share of secondary schools with internet and no curriculum rule.
